specs.title: CONTRACT-01: ScenarioSet v2 Root Schema & Canonical ID Compliance
CONTRACT-02: Intent ACCEPT_ORDER specifies required slots orderId and payment
CONTRACT-03: Declarative slotExtractors defined for integer and enum types
CONTRACT-04: Action payload template interpolation with canonical event type
CONTRACT-05: Terminal kind="end" is enforced for every scenario in set
CONTRACT-06: Schema contains zero targetState hints
WORKFLOW-01: Concurrent creation of 3 independent contexts (1001, 1002, 1003) with unique contextIds
WORKFLOW-02: Diverse completion of 3 contexts (1001->Card, 1002->Cancel, 1003->Cash) with exact contextId correlation
WORKFLOW-03: Context switching after completion and cancelled context resurrection protection
CROSS-CONTEXT-NEGATIVE: Zero invalid combinations with exact contextId and payload correlation
RECOVERY-04: Fourth context (1004) error recovery preserves states, contextIds, and executions of 1001-1003
IDEMP-03: Repeated slot filling on completed contexts preserves executionCount === 1 with contextId correlation
